narration:0:1521609001:0.text: As magic surges through you, a memory flashes before your eyes...
narration:0:1521609001:0.source_cn: 随着魔力的注入，你眼前出现了一段记忆……
narration:0:1521609001:0.male: As magic surges through you, a memory flashes before your eyes...
narration:0:1521609001:0.female: As magic surges through you, a memory flashes before your eyes...

say:6:1521609003:0.text: What's this, Father? My bag's already stuffed!
say:6:1521609003:0.source_cn: 老爹，你又拿了什么啊？你都给我塞了好多行李了！

say:7:1521609004:0.text: Oh, so now you're too good for your old man's help, huh?
say:7:1521609004:0.source_cn: 哟，瞧你那样，还嫌弃上你老爹我了？

say:8:1521609005:1.text: Listen up. This is a guardian statue.

say:9:1521609006:0.text: I pulled two all-nighters to make this. Keep it safe and don't lose it.
say:9:1521609006:0.source_cn: 你老爹我熬了两个通宵才做好，给我好好带上，不许弄丢了！

say:10:1521609007:1.text: Alright, alright. I won't lose it.
say:10:1521609007:1.source_cn: 好好好，我知道，肯定丢不了。

say:11:1521609008:1.text: It's time for me to be off.

say:12:1521609009:1.text: Aren't you gonna wait for your mother to come back? It'll be our last meal together for a while.
say:12:1521609009:1.source_cn: 不等你老娘回来吃顿饭吗？

say:13:1521609010:0.text: I can't. I'm hitching a ride on someone's carriage. If I don't make it on time, they'll leave.
say:13:1521609010:0.source_cn: 不了。我搭别人的马车，说好的就是这个时间，不能再拖了。

say:14:1521609011:0.text: I gotta go! I'll make sure to write to you and Mother.
say:14:1521609011:0.source_cn: 走了！我会记得给你们写信的！

say:17:1521609013:0.text: That little statue actually took you two days?
say:17:1521609013:0.source_cn: 就那么个小石像，居然还花了你两天时间？

say:18:1521609014:0.text: Your craft's slipping, Mason. Keep this up, and the shop'll go under.
say:18:1521609014:0.source_cn: 老石艺，你手艺是不是退步了啊？这么干下去，铺子迟早得黄吧。

say:19:1521609015:0.text: Come on, it's a gift for my boy. A little extra care won't wreck the schedule.
say:19:1521609015:0.source_cn: 那不是送给我儿子的吗，多花点时间怎么了，又不会耽误工期。

say:20:1521609016:0.text: See that huge rock over there? Someone actually commissioned me to carve a fountain out of it. Now that's a big job!
say:20:1521609016:0.source_cn: 喏，看到那边的大石头了吗？这次人家找我订了一个喷泉，这...

narration:22:1521609017:0.text: The echoing fragments of memory fade here. Whatever whispers pass between them now, you won't catch another word.
narration:22:1521609017:0.source_cn: 回响共鸣出的记忆片段到此为止，后续两人的耳语你再听不到了
narration:22:1521609017:0.male: The echoing fragments of memory fade here. Whatever whispers pass between them now, you won't catch another word.
narration:22:1521609017:0.female: The echoing fragments of memory fade here. Whatever whispers pass between them now, you won't catch another word.
